# Crowd fixtures

Test data for `tests/crowd/`. Nothing here is read by the agent at run time.

## Quarantine corpora

| File | What it is | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agentdojo_v1_corpus.json` | 302 real prompt-injection strings: every fixed-template attack AgentDojo registers (16), against every injection task of its four `v1` suites, generated by the real `agentdojo` 0.1.35 package's own `BaseAttack.attack()` with no model call. Every one must be withheld. | ARGUS `argus/src/argus/eval/baselines/agentdojo_attack_corpus.json` at commit `3dec6baf`; the generator script is inside the file (`_generator_source`) | AgentDojo strings: MIT, `AGENTDOJO_LICENSE.txt` (ETH Zurich SPY Lab, `ethz-spylab/agentdojo`, clone at commit `089ed468`). ARGUS metadata: MIT, same author as this project |
| `agentdojo_v122_heldout_corpus.json` | 390 strings from the same 16 templates against the `v1.2.2` suites. The injection goals differ from `v1`, so this is text no detection rule was written against. Every one must be withheld. | ARGUS `argus/src/argus/eval/baselines/agentdojo_heldout_v122_corpus.json`, same commit | as above |
| `AGENTDOJO_LICENSE.txt` | AgentDojo's MIT licence, copied from the clone | `research/repos-themed/ethz-spylab~agentdojo/LICENSE` | MIT |
| `live_headlines.json` | 49 real headlines from ARGUS's live feed. None may fire any rule. | ARGUS `argus/tests/data/live_headlines.json`, same commit | MIT, same author |
| `production_false_positives.json` | The six items the live ARGUS desk ever withheld, all audited as false positives: X's bidi isolates around a mention, ZWJ inside emoji, all-caps retail prose. None may be withheld. Author handles removed. | ARGUS `argus/data/quarantine_production_withholdings.json`, same commit | MIT, same author |
| `handwritten_sets.json` | `near_miss_prose` (10, must never be withheld), `paraphrases` (12 injections outside AgentDojo, must all be withheld), `semantic_injections` (20 injections that share no surface form with any rule; a measured limitation, see `test_quarantine.py`) | ARGUS `eval/quarantine_comparison.py:274,291` and `eval/quarantine_generalisation.py:88`, same commit | MIT, same author |

The ARGUS files were checked byte-identical (git blob hashes) to commit
`3dec6baf9dfa7be37c7b452e26a9b139df252f75` of the ARGUS repository on 2026-09-24. That repository
is private, so each file's SHA-256 and blob id, and the MIT licence, are recorded in
`third_party/argus/PROVENANCE.md`. They were
re-serialised with LF line endings; the data is unchanged, and each file names its origin in
`_vendored_from`.

A note on the corpus the build brief named: `agentdojo_injection_strings.json` in the build
session's scratch directory holds only `"Suite <name> failed checks"` errors for every attack and
suite, which is AgentDojo's `TaskSuite.check()` defect that ARGUS documents
(`_known_defect_in_the_reference` inside the corpus files). The strings used here come from the
per-pair `attack()` path that works, and match that session's `agentdojo_corpus.json` exactly.

## CLI output

| File | Shape |
|---|---|
| `x_search_ok.json` | `twitter search ... --json` success envelope, eight rows covering every parse branch |
| `x_search_empty.json` | success, no rows |
| `x_error_not_authenticated.json` | the error envelope twitter-cli prints when it finds no cookies (message from `twitter_cli/auth.py:607-620`) |
| `x_error_rate_limited.json` | HTTP 429 mapped to `rate_limited` (`twitter_cli/exceptions.py`, `TwitterAPIError`) |
| `reddit_search_ok.json` | `rdt search ... --json` success envelope: Reddit's own listing, eight children covering every parse branch |
| `reddit_search_empty.json` | success, no children |
| `reddit_error_forbidden.json` | HTTP 403 mapped to `forbidden` (`rdt_cli/transports.py:121-122`, prefixed by `search.py`) |
| `reddit_error_not_authenticated.json` | HTTP 401 mapped to `not_authenticated` |

The content is synthetic: no real post, account or session token is committed. The structure is
not: key sets, nesting, value types and formatting (`indent=2`, `ensure_ascii=False`) were checked
against one live read of each CLI (twitter-cli 0.8.5, rdt-cli 0.4.2) on 2026-09-24. Every X row
carries exactly the keys a live row carried; every Reddit post's keys are a subset of a live post's.
